ckpt_cfg.baseline: tolerance-Newton, exact-Helmholtz-preconditioned BiCGStab (n512/n1024 recipe); STANDARDISED across N

config.champion_rule: fastest variant whose mean trajectory error is within 1.02x of the base arm's (2.1764e-02)

encoder.note: retrained on t=0 pairs only (analytic blob_ic + the checkpoint's own codes); training data only, never test data

matched_accuracy.rule: cheapest (newton_tol, lin_tol) at least as accurate as the fastest ROM variant
